localSupplyDecouplingCapacitance.explanation: Recommended value per each of two distinct VM bypass positions, not a required minimum. This scalar schema cannot encode quantity two or the separate 0.1 uF flying, 1 uF VCP, 1 uF DVDD, and conditional 0.1 uF VCC capacitors. The current recipe's one-local-capacitor materialization is therefore incomplete for this exact MPN.
